instruction: Download all available week lecture slides from the CS50 Python 2022 course site to the lecture_slides folder, keeping the default file names.

metadata.explanation: Verifies total file count is at least 8 PDFs in /home/user/lecture_slides/ (including the pre-existing lecture0.pdf). Checks overall progress.
metadata.verification: Evaluated by checking file existence and count in /home/user/lecture_slides/ directory via bash ls command.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Instruction requires downloading 'all available' lecture slides, but evaluator only checks for minimum 8 files. CS50 Python 2022 has 10 weeks (0-9), so complete verification should check for 10 lecture PDFs.

No file naming validation: Instruction specifies 'keeping the default file names' (CS50 convention: lecture0.pdf, lecture1.pdf, etc.), but evaluator accepts any PDF files. Agent could download 8 random PDFs and pass.
No content verification: Evaluator doesn't verify that files are actually CS50 Python 2022 lecture slides from the correct source, only that they are PDFs in the target directory.

Pre-existing file handling issue: One PDF (lecture0.pdf) is pre-downloaded in config. Instruction says 'Download all available' slides, implying new downloads. Evaluator counts pre-existing file toward the 8 minimum, so agent could download only 7 new files and pass without completing the full task.
Coverage gap: Evaluator checks quantity (>=8 files) but not quality (correct files with correct names from correct source).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected.rules to check for exactly 10 PDF files (or min_files: 10) to match CS50 Python 2022's 10-week structure.
Add file naming pattern verification: Check that files follow the pattern lecture0.pdf, lecture1.pdf, ..., lecture9.pdf using regex matching in the metric function.
Consider verifying file sizes or checksums to ensure downloaded files are legitimate CS50 lecture slides, not arbitrary PDFs.
Either: (1) exclude lecture0.pdf from the count since it's pre-existing, and check for 9 new downloads, or (2) clarify that the task includes verifying the pre-existing file is present.
Enhance getter to return file details (names, not just count) and metric to validate naming convention matches CS50 default pattern.
